data.name: Koppula
data.gender_notes: Koppula is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Koppu means lotus and Kula means pond. This name signifies the beauty and peacefulness of a lotus flower blooming in the pond. The name Koppula carries the meaning “Lotus in the pond” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Telugu, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Koppula usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus in the pond and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual growth of an individual, who despite facing numerous challenges and obstacles, remains steadfast and continues to bloom and thrive like the lotus in the pond.
data.etymology: Koppula belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lotus in the pond.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Koppula total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Koppula is thought to have originated in the southern Indian state of Andhra Pradesh. The name is composed of two parts: Koppu and Kula. Koppu is derived from the Telugu word "koppu," which means lotus. Lotus flowers are commonly associated with Hindu culture due to their many symbolic and spiritual meanings. Lotus flowers bloom beautifully in ponds and are often used as symbols of purity, creation, and detachment from material desires. Kula, the second part of the name, comes from the Telugu word "kula," which means pond. Thus, Koppula is a name that signifies the beauty and peacefulness of a lotus flower blooming in a pond.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Koppula is deeply significant. It is a reminder of the divine lotus that is our own spiritual Self, which unfolds and blooms when we immerse ourselves in the inner pond of pure consciousness. In Hinduism, the lotus is also a symbol of the god Vishnu and his avatar Krishna, who are often depicted sitting or standing on a lotus flower. The lotus is also a symbol of the divine Mother, who is often depicted as having lotus petals at her feet. Thus, the name Koppula not only symbolizes the beauty and peacefulness of the natural world, but also reminds us of the spiritual truths and realities that lie within.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Koppula: Derived from the Sanskrit word "Koppa" meaning 'happiness' and "ula" meaning 'strength'. This name signifies one who exudes inner joy and possesses unwavering resilience.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Priya Koppula in Kathmandu, Nepal attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Koppula, which means "Lotus in the pond". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
